name: venue-workspace
description: Venue On My Plate — production monorepo for the API and operations console

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,admin -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @vomp/api" "npm run dev --workspace @vomp/admin"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,admin -c magenta,cyan "npm run start --workspace @vomp/api" "npm run start --workspace @vomp/admin"
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace @vomp/api && npm run lint --workspace @vomp/admin && npm run typecheck --workspace @vomp/admin && npm run build --workspace @vomp/admin
scripts.test: npm run check --workspace @vomp/api && npm run smoke --workspace @vomp/api
